flows.name: Borrow an item
flows.description: From finding a drill to reserving it for pickup.
flows.purpose: Lets a neighbor request an item while making sure it is reserved for only one person.
flows.entryPoint: A neighbor selects “Request to borrow” · POST /loans
flows.output: A reserved item and an agreed pickup
guarantees: An item can have only one active borrower
Only signed-in members can request items
Pickup details stay private until confirmation

flows.name: Return an item
flows.description: Owner confirmation makes the item ready for its next loan.
flows.purpose: Records the end of a loan and checks what should happen to the returned item.
flows.output: A completed loan and updated item availability
guarantees: Only the owner can confirm the return
An item stays unavailable until its return is confirmed
The same availability rules apply to returns and new requests

flows.name: Join a waitlist
flows.description: Get in line for an item that is already borrowed.
flows.purpose: Gives neighbors a fair queue for popular items, with automatic offers planned for the next update.
guarantees: A member can join an item waitlist only once
Positions follow the order members joined
Automatic offers are planned work, not a shipped feature

flows.name: Pickup reminders
flows.description: A useful nudge before the owner and borrower meet.
flows.purpose: Reduces missed pickups by reminding both neighbors before their agreed time.
flows.output: One reminder per member and pickup
guarantees: Cancelled pickups do not send reminders
Retried jobs do not send duplicate emails

flows.name: List an item with photos
flows.description: Help neighbors recognize what they are borrowing.
flows.purpose: Creates a listing with a clear title, category, and photo preview.
flows.entryPoint: The owner selects “List an item” · POST /items
flows.output: A searchable item listing with photos
guarantees: Only the owner can edit a listing
Large photos use small previews in search

flows.name: Download lending history
flows.description: A private record of things you have borrowed and lent.
flows.purpose: Planned export lets a member keep a copy of their own lending history.
flows.entryPoint: The member selects “Download my history” · GET /history/export
flows.output: CSV containing the member’s own loans
guarantees: Only your own loans are included
Export does not change the original records
